focus: Other .skilled surfaces where the same judgment pays off, with seam inventory
ruledOut: Fetch surface as the only candidate

label: The fetch surface is real and unscreened: 82 WebFetch + 61 WebSearch records across 31/486 state files; grants in at least .claude (2 agents) and .opencode (webfetch: allow).
No fetch seam exists, but PostToolUse seams for Bash (settings:210-215) and Write|Edit (198-208) prove command hooks run on tool results today; the MCP PreToolUse guard (88-95) is the third sibling.

The same noul judgment already pays in 047's scorer family (030 keep, 025 keep, 024 keep; 026 margin stop, 033 precision kill); the injection screen is a port of an established pattern with reusable keep rule, run-dir convention and transport.
Candidate surfaces ranked: WebFetch/WebSearch first for fit, Bash output first for seam availability (parked by 035, broadest surface), then MCP responses, sk_vision_ocr text, child executor stdout.

The vendored product's own `jev screen` subcommand is excluded today (version pin refuses it; missing answer defaults to 0), so the measured noul core is a candidate replacement for its model question.
Rule 16 states the untrusted-content principle with no mechanism and names the missing allowlist as a known limitation; a hook-seam screen is the mechanical complement.
